source_policy: Fixed upstream APIs and responsibilities are retained. MH1 and the Main-required zero-layer sphere-target MH2 instance are proved. User explicitly authorized one public alias in Standard and Main now consumes it. The frozen general MH2 is privately refuted and remains registered off-route, along with GL1/GL2; its source and type/body fingerprints are unchanged. No new axiom, sorry or responsibility is introduced, and upstream sorry-freedom is not claimed.

status_definitions.original-paper-target-without-proof: The pinned source recorded an actual-model target as a proposition definition without a proof. Turning it into a callable pending theorem does not mean its proof existed previously.
status_definitions.existing-proof-archived-port-pending: The referenced old declaration/argument has a proof body without a direct sorry; current type-compatible adaptation remains pending. This does not certify the old proof transitive dependencies.
status_definitions.original-paper-proof-gaps-retained: A direct proof gap already occurred in the pinned article implementation. It remains a paper-local obligation, not an accepted outside fact.
status_definitions.original-paper-proof-gaps-and-proof-port: Both original proof gaps and adaptation of already written proof text remain.
status_definitions.external-upstream-duty: Construction, compatibility, cited external theorem or computation correctness belongs to its upstream module, even if legacy source lived under Main. It is not repeated as a Main obligation.
status_definitions.adapted-proof-body-present: Current proof body has no direct sorry. Its transitive dependencies may still contain pending upstream or local paper proofs.

The existing quotient/shift comparison now retains the lambda and boundary-projection squares from the same triangle morphism, as well as its inclusion square. All previous stretching representatives and public premises are preserved; this strengthened private comparison supports shifted delta no-crossing.

The forward classical-differential to absolute lambda-quotient boundary comparison is proved with actual representatives, lambda powers, filtrations and infinity labels. Reverse proves the complementary differential comparison; CrossingDelta and CrossingShift now prove the complete classical delta no-crossing conversion.

Actual finite and infinite E-infinity windows identify classical labels and precisely characterize nonzero lambda images by the paper boundary exclusion. No strict extension-lifting assertion is made.

A finite essential extension has source displacement less than the quotient exponent. Consequently the actual page-two extension map has no higher-source crossings; the general conversion remains pending. The additional minimal-length exclusion is proved in CrossingFinite.

Finite induction on actual filtrations proves representative correction and four-edge synchronization under TowerNoCrossing. The new converse construction turns same-source-grade, higher-target-filtration corrections into the full actual TowerNoCrossing condition. The delta crossing premise is now supplied by CrossingDelta and CrossingShift; the general finite/infinite f conversion remains separate.
The absolute quotient boundary and its strict naturality square are proved for the prescribed quotient and suspension maps. Commutativity does not supply a crossing conclusion.

A high-filtration absolute boundary gives the exact lambda divisibility needed to lift the prescribed source through a higher quotient; its unchanged first label is therefore a classical cycle. This proves the reverse survival implication, not the final differential target comparison.

Existing actual-quotient exactness and octahedra produce the same restriction lift and a lambda preimage of its second image. The actual normalized triangle and unit relative lambda triangle are also instantiated in May after rotation; may_tensor_common_lift proves both signed tensor equations for the same c. Comparison of this tensor instance with the fixed Q(X) maps and bigraded sphere source is still pending. No arbitrary lambda preimage is identified with the specified ag representative.

The HF2 universal-coefficient comparison proves exponent two for classical Adams pages. Negation transports actual detected representatives; actual homotopy groups are not assumed to have exponent two.

For a specified finite-quotient representative, its first label and absolute boundary detection imply the actual classical differential. Adjacent-lift ambiguity is controlled modulo the actual boundary group. GL2 now uses this result; construction of its synchronized representative remains pending.

The finite filtration window and quotient-triangle exactness give strict source lambda division. The prescribed lambda and absolute boundary maps form a proved square up to an explicit target isomorphism, with two-way filtration transport. These results now support the complete delta no-crossing conversion in CrossingDelta; they do not assert compatible division of an arbitrary f-extension relation.

The private unshifted g-cofiber isomorphism now uses the fully faithful inverse of the negative g shift and the actual normalizedConnecting tail, followed only by the canonical biShiftAddIso. This proves its exact inclusion formula through negativeLift(h) and nu.suspensionIso, without identifying separately chosen suspension-commutation structures. The original shifted boundary identity is retained exactly and rewritten through the raw cofiber isomorphism; it still contains the original negative-g commShift, so canonical f transport and the second May identity are not asserted.

The complete classical NoCrossingOn to actual absolute-boundary TowerNoCrossing implication is proved with no added hypotheses. Strict source lambda division, the reverse survival comparison, BHS differential existence and a zero-target forward boundary representative produce the required same-source-grade correction.

Strict lambda division of an actual finite normalized-map source and filtration of its image are proved in the fixed quotient. They exclude higher-source essential crossings in the minimal normalized-length range m <= e(f). In the range m <= e(f)+1, every possible crossing has u=s+1, v=s+e(f)+1 and m=e(f)+1. This position constraint does not prove the next-length no-crossing conversion or the general finite f conversion.

The complete absolute-boundary no-crossing implication is transported to every vertical shift of nu X, including the normalized source object. The quotient/shift comparison retains its actual projection square and proves filtration compatibility for the fixed boundary map.

Quotient restriction maps that agree on the actual inclusion agree after evaluation on spheres in the no-return range. Chosen quotient/shift comparisons therefore preserve the strict restriction equation of the same desuspended representative. MH2 now uses this transport for its prescribed lift in unshifted nu X.

Classical differential no-crossing makes the relative quotient boundary identical for representatives with the same first grade: the absolute-boundary image difference has filtration beyond the complementary finite-quotient window. This handles the differential no-crossing branch of MH2 representative synchronization; the general h-extension branch and simultaneous May image equation remain pending.

Removal of the specified zero vertical shift preserves finiteNuLabel with a=0 as the prescribed finiteTargetLabel, and transports detection along the actual quotient map of shiftZero.hom, for every quotient length and lambda label index. The proof uses the quotient inclusion square and the target-label definition. It does not assert compatibility for positive vertical shift a=1 or for nu.suspensionIso with the classical DesuspendsClass relation.

Actual finite lambda division is constructed from the detected source, uniformly including exponent zero. The divided representative has source label congruent to the original label modulo a boundary, and the resulting classical differential is invariant under this ambiguity. The unified reverse wrapper requires only the actual lambda equation and the specified divided boundary detection; it chooses the first label internally.

The complete infinite normalized-map extension equation is pushed through the actual lambda power and absolute-boundary suspension, retaining both actual source and target infinity classes and their transported E2 representatives. This is a forward propagation only; no-crossing preservation and comparison with the specified left-edge class remain separate.

The actual rho lift preserves detection of the original label, via finite filtration reflection and injectivity on E-infinity. Later cycles follow from the higher finite window. GL1 uses the resulting weighted right-edge survival theorem.

The actual boundaries before and after finite lambda division have strictly equal Q1 labels. The difference between the selected exact shift comparison and canonical suspension is a natural automorphism of the represented homotopy functor. Yoneda identifies its action with a sphere automorphism, whose Q1 action is proved trivial. No global equality of the two shift comparisons is assumed.

The fixed sphere first quotient is identified with the additive group ZMod 2 using the registered actual sphere coordinates and archive_dimension(0,0). Every sphere automorphism acts trivially after Q1. Actual quotient-shift and quotient-map naturality extend this to every bigraded sphere and arbitrary synthetic target. This does not assert that unquotiented homotopy groups have characteristic two.

The weighted absolute-boundary detection is converted into the classical differential. A higher rho lift retains source detection, actual lambda division gives the correct source modulo boundaries, and the strict Q1 boundary comparison determines the target. The final target ambiguity is contained in the permitted B_k. All zero and endpoint cases are included without a new hypothesis.

The actual quotient/absolute-boundary square is assembled from three TowerExtensionEquation inputs and their no-crossing conditions. One right-edge representative has the specified finite label and its own specified boundary label. Canonical ESS shift transport gives unshifted boundary detection; the GL1 version only requires the top target label and gives high boundary filtration without a bottom label assumption.

The actual finite and infinite extension witnesses supply the top edge and the lambda-propagated bottom edge with all degree transports checked. The private assembly wrappers use the proved bottom target label comparison for GL2. Their remaining inputs are the left-edge label match and crossing conversions.

A chosen octahedron produces a common lift of two prescribed compatible images. The actual finite quotient triangle constructs the same intermediate vertex from aZ and the prescribed ag. Its comparison into the fixed Q_(i+q)(Cg) has the correct restriction on every sphere by the proved finite no-return window bound; its second image is a fixed K evaluated on the prescribed input. The actual identification of that K evaluation with the signed lambda transition remains separate. Both constructions are called by MH2. Two private conditional comparison lemmas factor K-J through the shifted first arrow when delta followed by K equals delta followed by J, and show equality on a prescribed boundary representative. They do not prove this compatibility for the standard May lambda map, and are not yet used to close MH2.

The actual lambda/shift propagation of the unshifted Y infinity target retains the prescribed classical target label. Positive lambda powers are identified with the registered infinityLambda window map; exponent zero is proved from the actual shift unit and filtered graded comparison. The resulting target label is supplied directly to the GL2 square wrapper without a new local assumption.

From an actual finite extension witness, positive length implies zero leading E2 image on both the finite quotient and the unquotiented normalized map. A common shift preserves the finite version by actual shifted representatives and filtration. Zero length gives the specified target as the exact finite and unquotiented E2 image. These eleven private lemmas have complete proofs, but do not establish the May K/J comparison, shifted inclusion naturality on nonpermanent labels, h-source first-quotient compatibility, or the final MH2 boundary-controlled division; the main MH2 proof does not yet call them.

For every positive finite quotient length, a normalized source detected by the prescribed classical bottom label is transported to an actual unshifted representative with that same first-quotient label and Detects. Both exponent-zero and exponent-one branches retain a strict inverse transport equation, and the quotient comparisons are chosen internally. The positive branch calls the newly authorized upstream firstQuotient_positive_shift responsibility.

The actual classical/synthetic suspension transports a bottom-weight finite quotient representative to the prescribed unsuspended first-quotient label and Detects, with internally chosen quotient comparisons and strict inverse transport. This calls the newly authorized firstQuotient_suspension responsibility. Only lambda exponent zero is covered here; positive lambda layers and the full MH2 target comparison remain separate.

The actual finite extension witness supplies a source and its detected target. For normalized exponent zero or one, the source is unshifted with its prescribed label. Differential no-crossing gives strict equality of its relative boundary with the original boundary representative. An unconditional internal selector retains the original representative when that no-crossing hypothesis fails, and records the actual extension-at-source conclusion when it holds. The two private predicates describe only these proved conclusions; they introduce no assumptions or pending responsibilities.

From the existing bi-shift coherence and lambda centrality, prove shift compatibility of every lambda power. The two finite lambda comparison maps agree after inclusion; their difference factors through a boundary with weight -q-1 and vanishes on every sphere by no-return. This proves the actual finiteLambdaClass suspension/unshift equality, with no additional upstream statement or local assumption.

For the actual finite-quotient representative detecting the suspended class at any retained lambda layer 0 <= k < q, prove that its actual desuspension detects the prescribed unsuspended class. BHS supplies a bottom-layer comparison representative, the authorized first-quotient suspension fixes its label, and the proved finite lambda equality plus preservation of higher filtration handles the original representative. The zero and positive layers cover the entire MH2 h-target window. Identification with the cofiber lift aNu remains a separate actual-map comparison.

Consume the original finite h extension witness and its actual source relation. Reindex the suspended target, apply the proved suspension detection bridge and strict cofiber representative equality, and conclude that the actual aNu detects the prescribed lambda^(l-e(h)) x. Both raw geometric and native finiteTargetLabel degrees are provided. No new crossing or label assumptions are added.

Preserve the specified finiteTargetLabel under the actual rho lift in the retained lambda window. Its E-infinity detection gives a firstLabel lift in Q_(j-k)(nuZero X), with the exact original class x, by the existing finite BHS interface. This is the MH2 source survival step once the actual h restriction has its prescribed detection; the other no-crossing branch and second May image remain separate.

Prove cancellation of the actual negative normalized lift using bi-shift associativity and units. The canonical g-cofiber inclusion, shifted by e(h), is exactly the normalized h map followed by the actual nu suspension. No compatibility of independently chosen suspension-commutation structures is assumed.

Compare the actual finite h-target and canonical g-cofiber inclusion on sphere representatives. Quotient comparison choices cancel by finite no-return, and coherent inverse shifts give strict equality with the cofiber restriction aNu. The wrapper uses the existing FiniteSourceUnshifts relation; no additional public or local proof assumptions are introduced.

Prove the actual unquotiented cofiber edge defect and its common desuspension, retaining both the d_0 h_0 correction and the original G t_0 residual. This is a strict morphism equality; no E2 additivity or prescribed second May label is assumed or concluded.

Every sphere automorphism preserves finiteTargetLabel detection in all retained lambda layers. Consequently an arbitrary natural automorphism of a bi-shift, transported through an actual finite quotient comparison, preserves the detected label. Identification of the concrete exact/canonical f transports remains separate.

Construct canonical common edge coordinates D_0=shift(0,i)(Q_(i+q) A) and factor Jedge strictly through the actual finite lambda transition on the original detected ag. For normalized exponent zero or one, that finite transition inverse-transports to the specified native lambda_i y label without requiring y permanent. This does not identify K with J.

Define exact and canonical suspension transports and compare their detected finite labels through a natural automorphism. The raw cofiber boundary is the negative actual suspended normalized f map. The constructed actual source alpha has strict f image equal to the transported same raw boundary, with its detected target inherited from the canonical transport. Detection of alpha as the prescribed source remains a separate step.

Every accumulated classical boundary in B_(k+1) has an actual nu representative with its prescribed first label and annihilated by lambda^k, including k=0. The proof extracts the first death page and uses the existing selected boundary realization. This supplies a special torsion correction, without asserting that it lies in any prescribed normalized-map image.

At minimal extension length n=e(f), the original source is reselected to the prescribed unshifted finite representative. Higher-filtration source differences and the proved minimal-length tower no-crossing preserve the original target. The main h-source selector consumes this when l=e(h).

For the actual common-shift defect, construct the finite-cycle d_0 correction with zero rho_i, and subtract that same correction without changing rho_i. Positive g length kills the Gt_0 E2 image. At zero length, preserve the same raw t and prove its transposed lambda_i factor annihilates the specified differential target at E-infinity. A strengthened private defect construction retains the raw maps and transpose. Comparing the defect on the specified nonpermanent finite source remains separate.

Actual finite lambda classes commute with every bigraded shift and inverse quotient transport. A prescribed bottom first label therefore detects the exact original finite lambda label after inverse transport. No extra positive-source weighted E2 naturality is assumed.

Divide the actual detected lambda^k x representative in a finite quotient while retaining its exact long lambda image and exact firstLabel x, using the accumulated-boundary torsion correction. An actual target already in the required filtration has a detected classical label; comparison after lambda gives precisely B_(i+1) ambiguity. The final conditional assembler retains the actual f source, actual image, both Detects and strict f equation. Simultaneous preservation of the required f-image filtration is not proved.

Compare the actual signed normalized f-source transport with the canonical total shift using a natural automorphism. Two consecutive quotient shifts and inverse transports agree with the single total transport up to a specified sphere automorphism, which preserves all retained finite lambda labels. The main total cNu transport can therefore supply the same label to the nested actual f source once the raw cofiber coordinates are instantiated. No equality of the independent commShift choices or homotopy characteristic-two assumption is used.

Construct the actual common eC coordinates from the chosen g-cofiber isomorphism and the same quotient/shift comparison. The common-desuspended cGeometry is strictly the positive vertical shift of the same cNu. Flatten the canonical eD coordinates through the chosen quotient comparison and preserve actual K/J/t preimages. These are coordinate identities, not an assertion that the May defect vanishes.

When the unquotiented nu-source is isomorphic to an actual bigraded sphere, prove whole-map high-window vanishing and quotient extension existence. Extensions agree on actual sphere representatives. Correct the same v by the same alpha composed with dQ; preserve rho and detect the prescribed J image once the original residual detects zero. This avoids E2 morphism additivity and applies only under the explicit sphere-source hypothesis.

For the original actual g extension witness, prove the same raw common-desuspended residual detects zero, using positive-length E2 vanishing or the zero-length specified differential and transposed lambda factor. Flatten to the actual native target with normalized exponent retained. Reindex the original finiteSource detection to the same native ag without changing its representative.

Instantiate the sphere-source May correction on the original normalized T, actual phi/K/v and prescribed ag. The same raw d/t from the actual common defect gives the residual, including the zero-length differential case. Produce c-prime with the original rho_i image and detected actual Jq label; no second-May equation is assumed. Conversion of that Jq label to the final native lambda_i y and non-spherical-source coverage remain separate.

Use the actual normalized nu-cofiber triangle and two balanced sphere ends to prove whole-map high-window vanishing for nuCofiber, including every integer classical shift. Construct actual quotient extensions and the same-alpha May edge correction, preserving rho and the specified J label. A generic private correction lemma factors out the common extension argument. No statement is made for detector or arbitrary nu sources.

Prove finite h no-crossing conversion for n<=e(f)+1, with actual source lambda division, classical cycle extraction, the short minimal witness, essentiality and exact B_2 exclusion. The final wrapper reselects the given unshifted aZ in the original witness and preserves its specified target. The main h-source selector consumes this for k<=1; the remaining finite h branch has k>=2.

Strictly identify the main proof quotientShiftDesuspend followed by its native degree transport with quotientUnshift. The resulting wrapper consumes cGeometry in its original BiHom degrees and the same cNu detection, and supplies the actual normalized f-source detection without a new label premise.

From the same actual cGeometry and its total quotient-unshift detection, construct actual raw, normalized-source and suspension quotient comparisons. The actual signed f source alpha formed from that same raw representative detects the prescribed native lambda^k x after inverse normalized-exponent transport. No additional detection assumption is introduced.

At k=0, refold the same inverse-normalized finite source detection to the prescribed finite source label for both normalized exponents. Given the actual May target detection for that same source, assemble af, bf and y-prime=y with the strict f equation and exact boundary congruence. This does not construct the remaining actual May target detection.

Formal diagnostic facts: adding a B_(k+1) boundary to a length-k target preserves the same actual finite-extension witness and E-infinity target. Positive f extensions force the normalized leading E2 image to vanish; a nonzero boundary image therefore obstructs source translation. Existing upstream interfaces also give the nonzero boundary d2(h4) and vanishing Ext^(2,13). These proved private results identify the exact-source lambda division issue; the complete unconditional negation is now proved separately in StatementReview.
